Terraria: The Complete 100% Achievement Guide (1.4.5 UPDATED)
A complete detailed achievement guide on how to earn all 137 achievements in Terraria
By melmagicmage
Welcome to the Guide!
Thank you for opening this guide! Not much to say apart from, 1 guide. 137 Achievements. Lets get into it.
ATTENTION: If you're struggling on a specific achievement you can save yourself some time looking through this guide and press CTRL+F to search for the specific achievement. This is a very lengthy guide.
1.4.5 ACHIEVEMENTS
The most recent Bigger and Boulder update (update version 1.4.5) has added 22 new achievements. Because of formatting limits, I have split the update's achievements into two sections one for all the Zenith world achievements and one for the rest of them.

Going Oldschool
Going Oldschool
Bring back the original title screen.
How to earn achievement
Click and hold on the sun in the main menu of the game and move it around you should unlock this achievement.

Sea You Later
Sea You Later (crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
Craft the final upgrade to the Cell Phone.
Crafting Recipe for Shellphone

Magic conch - found in hardmode desert fishing crates
Demon conch - found by fishing in lava
Cellphone - see crafting recipe in 'labor of love achievements' section

Fortune Favors the Bould
Fortune Favors the Bould
Discover a friendly boulder.
How to find friendly boulder
Friendly boulders are found deep underground and are hard to miss as they have a glowing rainbow aura around them. Hit/mine them to activate them and you will get the achievement.

Book Worm
Book Worm
Catalogue every creature in the world.
Complete the Bestiary

Rollin’ In Your Grave
Rollin’ In Your Grave
Take a ride in your final resting place.
Ride the coffin minecart
Crafting recipe for the coffin minecart (at the anvil):
  • 5 Iron / Lead Bars
  • 10 of any wood
  • 10 rotten chunks or vertebrae
  • Make sure you are crafting in ecto mist (the fog that is generated when you place alot of graves)

Fear The Sun
Fear The Sun
Dawn the garb of a vampire and get a sunburn.
How to get achievement
Create a world with the vampire seed (type 'whatahorriblenighttohaveacurse' into the seed search bar and you should be able to create it. Have the vampire vanity set equipped (either armor or vanity slots is fine), the set is dropped from special bags dropped during halloween from every mob.
The thing about this seed is since you take damage out in the sun, you will spawn in the caves. Dig your way up to the surface and wait for the sun.

Spicy Licks
Spicy Licks
Jam out on a six stringed instrument.
How to get achievement
Play one of the few guitars that are in the game:
  • Ivy - Dropped by the steampunker if their name is Whitney
  • Rain Song - Rare drop from flying fish
  • Stellar Tune - Dropped by the Empress of Light boss
  • The Axe - Dropped by Plantera boss

Training Day
Training Day
Get your villagers fully combat ready.
How to get achievement
Use the advanced combat techniques and advanced combat techniques volume two - permanent buffing items which are applied to npc's.

Advanced combat techniques - an extremely rare drop from fishing
Advanced combat techniques: volume two - obtained when throwing a spell tome into a pool of shimmer

New Digs
New Digs
Give any villager a new look.
How to get achievement
Douse one of your NPC's in shimmer to transform them.

Organized Chaos
Organized Chaos
Find the ultra rare Rod of Discord.
How to get Rod of Discord
The rod of discord is a really rare drop from elementals in the underground hallow biome.

Conservationist
Conservationist
Support sustainable logging by planting 100 acorns.
Plant 100 acorns

It’s Shaling Outside
It’s Shaling Outside
Survive the dreaded rain of boulders.
How to get achievement
Create a for the worthy world seed along with drunk world seed. For time efficiency, make it a journey world with a journey world character so you can control the weather. Make sure you are on surface.
Put the wind on maximum on the journey mode weather controls and switch between monsoon and clear sky weather controls. Keep switching between these rain settings until the boulder rain starts.

Extra Life
Extra Life
Die as a hardcore character and survive to tell the tale.
How to get achievment
Create a world in the constant + celebration mark 10 secrets seeds and die with a hardcore character in the world.

On Fleek
On Fleek
Spot the sun on a “cool” day.
Equip the sunglasses vanity item during a sunny day

Mini-Me
Mini-Me
Become a Moon Lord impersonator.
Equip the full moon lord set

Terrarist
Terrarist
Scare your villagers with a stink bug sword.
How to get achievement
Use the flymeal sword on an NPC.

Trash Compactor
Trash Compactor
Research 50% of all items in Journey Mode.
How to get achievement
In a journey mode world, you can research items by having them in your inventory. Research 50% of all in-game items.

Interdimensional Recycling
Interdimensional Recycling
Give the Dryad a can of Joja Cola.
How to get achievement
Give a Joja Cola can to the Dryad, this item has an uncommon chance of being fished up and is considered a 'junk item', so fish in very shallow water.
